verdict.rationale: A probe shows docs pages are served as raw markdown (introduction.md returns HTTP 200), and that page points agents to a full documentation index at https://rive.app/docs/llms.txt. Many doc URLs resolve as .md files, and the RML docs are written explicitly for coding agents and text-based workflows. Missing for 10: a direct probe confirming /docs/llms.txt resolves (the root /llms.txt returns 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
